The '''Services Sector''', also known as '''Vice Central''' was a region of the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The area was inhabited by numerous criminals and contained all of Darkside's shops and entertainment services. One of the region's most successful entertainment establishments was ''[[Lucky You]]'', a service that offered clients an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of make-believe, with amateur [[Actor/Legends|actors]] enacting the clients' fantasies.
